title: Trump Rules Out Further Strikes, Pivots to Economic Pressure on Iran
detail: President Trump signaled the US is shifting from military strikes to economic pressure on Iran, describing ongoing talks as only 'semi-negotiations' and saying Washington is going 'low key.' Trump stated there would be no more strikes on Iran for now, emphasizing that maximum economic sanctions — rather than continued airstrikes — would be the primary tool to compel Iranian concessions on its nuclear program and shipping behavior. The posture shift comes amid a fragile de-escalation following the collapse of the Islamabad MOU in early July 2026 and subsequent resumed US strikes. Trump did not announce a formal ceasefire or diplomatic breakthrough.

media.caption: Trump says US going 'low key,' stresses economic pressure over military operations on Iran
Trump says US is 'only semi-negotiating' with Iran
